Title: Inverted index
Body: An inverted index maps content, such as words, to its locations in a set of documents. It is the central data structure of a search engine.

Title: Okapi BM25
Body: BM25 is a ranking function used by search engines to estimate the relevance of documents to a given search query, based on term frequency and document length.

Title: Retrieval-augmented generation
Body: Retrieval-augmented generation lets a language model answer using documents retrieved at query time and cite them as sources.

Title: Is BM25 still worth it next to embeddings?
Body: Thread: several replies say hybrid search with BM25 plus dense embeddings beats either alone, especially on rare terms and product codes.

Title: Talk transcript: Block-Max WAND in Lucene
Body: Transcript: block-max WAND skips blocks of postings whose maximum score cannot enter the top k, which made Lucene disjunctions much faster.
